title: Thanksgiving 2025
description:
With the State College Wharton Family, the Florida Gall Cousin Family & the Texas Gall Cousin Family
Josh & Sarah’s Craft Cocktails & Libations
Sarah's Curated Collection of Charcuterie Confections
State College Lobster Bisque Shooters
Chris-Carved Buttermilk-Brined Airline Turkey Breast
With Sublime Gravy
Blake’s Turkey Leg Koji Confit
Ashley’s Famous Focaccia Stuffing
Morgan’s Mashed Potatoes
Sarah’s Roasted Sweet Potatoes
Josh’s Shaved Brussels Sprouts With Maple Syrup & Balsamic Glaze
Andrea’s Cranberry Surprise

Linda’s Apple Crisp &
Pumpkin Pie Bars
Now thank we all our God,
with heart and hands and voices,
whose wondrous things have been done,
in whom this world rejoices.
We have been blessed
with countless gifts of love,
and ever joyful hearts,
Full of grace & peace to cheer us.
All praise and thanks to God
whom heaven and earth adore.
For thus it was … is now …
and shall be evermore.
Amen
